skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand, analyze and apply the general knowledge about the concept, existence and development of environmental law, the objects regulated, the methods of regulation, the sources of law and the basic content of environmental law in Vietnam. Basic knowledge about international environmental law.
Analyze and apply legal provisions on environmental impact assessment, strategic environmental assessment, and environmental control.
Understand, analyze and apply legal provisions on the control of environmental pollution and degradation, including air, water, soil, forests, aquatic resources, and cultural heritage.
Understand, analyze and apply mechanisms for resolving environmental disputes.
Apply group work skills, communication, presentation, and computer usage skills to find legal texts and information in the field of environmental protection.
Analyze and synthesize information on legal situations arising in the field of environmental protection.
Apply skills to solve legal problems.
Develop the ability to independently study, accumulate and improve knowledge.
Develop the ability to plan and implement tasks, propose initiatives during the execution of assigned tasks.
